Skin reactions. The Australian Adverse Drug Reactions Advi- sory Committee (ADRAC)1 has received 51 reports of allergic skin reactions with glucosamine, including erythematous rash, angioedema, urticaria, rash, and pruritus. It was noted that some preparations contain glucosamine sourced from seafood and therefore people with an allergy to shellfish may be at greater risk for hypersensitivity reactions. 1. Adverse Drug Reactions Advisory Committee (ADRAC). Skin reactions with glucosamine. Aust Adverse Drug React Bull 2005; 24: 23.
